source_gap_claims.behavior: A positive detached Probe must pass, not merely execute as an independent process with bound inputs and outputs.
source_gap_claims.reason: The positive-Probe obligation requires independent execution and bindings but does not require a passing terminal result.
source_gap_claims.subject: Positive Probe oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Probe must independently bind its actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed Probe obligations require bound inputs and outputs, but omit separate binding of actual target, command, and result.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe identity and execution receipt

source_gap_claims.behavior: A candidate must not select the Validator Capability identity or establish its own trust.
source_gap_claims.reason: Candidate-external trust is independently verified, but no obligation expressly rejects candidate-controlled validator selection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator Capability selection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validator version text alone must not establish trust.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligation set verifies validator source and content, but does not prohibit accepting descriptive version text as trust proof.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator version evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every retained evaluation seed must use only anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, or non_baseline_exploratory_candidate classification.
source_gap_claims.reason: The named-seed obligations require an approved non-baseline classification without representing the closed allowed classification set.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed classification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Stable eligibility requires a verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior, and a temporary package cannot qualify merely because it differs from Candidate.
source_gap_claims.reason: Matrix obligations require immutable Stable and Candidate subjects but do not require Stable provenance or reject temporary substitute Stable packages.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Candidate must contain the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The matrix obligations require Candidate execution and immutability but do not require Candidate to contain the evaluated real change.
source_gap_claims.subject: Candidate Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: The Consumer Manifest must be non-empty and frozen before review.
source_gap_claims.reason: The reconciliation obligation requires completeness and bidirectionality but does not require non-emptiness or pre-review freezing.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer Manifest lifecycle

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Consumer must bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: Consumer route-transition obligations require real calls but do not require complete per-Consumer execution identity bindings.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer execution receipt

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each behavioral obligation requires its own observable fault witness and every other obligation requires a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: Exact Cover obligations require graph relationships but do not require the distinct witness kinds and per-obligation witness semantics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Atomic Obligation witness requirements

source_gap_claims.behavior: Budget exhaustion must never reduce coverage.
source_gap_claims.reason: The budget-exhaustion obligation requires an unsuccessful outcome but omits preservation of coverage.
source_gap_claims.subject: Bounded-execution coverage
